test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

To be in the driving seat

options.text: To be in charge or control of a situation
To avoid speaking up on something
To be able to drive a vehicle
To allow other people to go past yourself

solution:
The correct answer is:** '****To be in charge or control of a situation**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **appropriate meaning** of the given idiom **'To be in the driving seat'** is **'To be in charge or control of a situation'**.
 
• A **group of words** with a **definite order** known as an **idiom** have a single, distinct meaning from the meanings of the individual words.
 
• The idiom** '****To be in the driving seat'** refers to someone or something **being in charge **or **in control** of a situation.

 
• *​​*Thus from the explanation given above, we find that the 1st option is the correct choice.
